title: When the Gravity Sings
author: Wendell Ravensworth
blurb: Elodie Sandoval, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
